_comment: Reference for recurring cars across TrackMarc's events -- it's a small regular Irish track day/drift scene, so the same physical car turns up at multiple events months apart. When captioning a new batch (manually or reviewing a Gemini pass), grep this file for a distinctive livery/sponsor/plate before assuming a car is new. Add an entry whenever you confirm the same car reappearing (see car-711 below for how it was found: matching sponsor text across two events' photos). Not read by any script or page -- purely a lookup for whoever's doing the captioning.

cars.description: BMW E46 coupe, candy apple red, 'Ecohome' + 'AMF Car Parts' + 'BM Concrete' sponsor livery, driver M. Kairaitis, race number 711
seenAt: Drift Games Summer Bash 2026 (DSC_7399-Enhanced-NR.jpg, DSC_7613-Enhanced-NR.jpg, DSC_7614-Enhanced-NR.jpg, DSC_7615-Enhanced-NR.jpg, DSC_7678-Enhanced-NR.jpg)
cars.note: Originally miscaptioned as 'copper' (Bimmerfest) and plain 'red' (Drift Games) before Marc confirmed candy apple red -- fixed 2026-08-23.

cars.description: Nissan Silvia S15, white/pink/blue livery, 'Valino' + 'Sixth Element' + 'Shanahan Tyres' sponsor branding, race number/plate 'PRO 99', driver Philip Ireland
seenAt: Drift Games Summer Bash 2026 (DSC_7253-Enhanced-NR.jpg, DSC_8340-Enhanced-NR-2.jpg, DSC_8344-Enhanced-NR-2.jpg, DSC_8345-Enhanced-NR-2.jpg, DSC_8358-Enhanced-NR-2.jpg)
cars.note: Gemini alternated between 'S14' and 'S15' across these 5 photos of the same car -- confirmed S15 from the front fascia (narrow angular headlights integrated into the bumper corners, not the bulkier separated S14 units). Fixed 2026-08-26; 3 of the 5 entries were wrong (S14).

cars.description: White Toyota Cresta (X100 generation), plate 99-MH-15123 (Gemini has misread this as 99-MH-15723 and 99-MH-5123 on different photos -- same plate, same car). At 86 Fest this was Shinji Minowa's (D1GP legend, headline guest) loaner car for the weekend -- he's the driver/standing next to it in all 86 Fest appearances. Same plate also appears at Drift Games Summer Bash 2026 under what's presumably a different regular owner/driver, weeks before 86 Fest -- don't apply the Minowa connection to those photos.
seenAt: 86 Fest 2026 (DSC_1440-Enhanced-NR.jpg, DSC_1450-Enhanced-NR.jpg, DSC_1454-Enhanced-NR.jpg, DSC_1462-Enhanced-NR.jpg, DSC_2517-Enhanced-NR.jpg -- all Shinji Minowa driving/loaner)
Drift Games Summer Bash 2026 (DSC_7446-Enhanced-NR.jpg -- same plate, not Minowa, predates 86 Fest)
cars.note: Gemini repeatedly misidentified this as a 'Toyota Chaser' or 'Toyota Mark II' -- it's a Cresta, the third badge-engineered sibling on the same JZX100 platform (Chaser/Cresta/Mark II are near-identical apart from grille and taillight details). Fixed 2026-09-07 per Marc's correction. Also: Gemini invented a false celebrity ID for Shinji Minowa in one photo (DSC_1494-Enhanced-NR.jpg), captioning him as 'Keiichi Tsuchiya' -- a real but completely different person. Always verify a named-person ID against context (guest list, who's actually confirmed to be at the event) rather than trusting a model's specific identity claim.
